comment: With one document open nothing a painter sees changes: a stroke still draws, because the easel now hears its own document's composite request rather than the bus's, and a new document in another colour space still moves the status line, the blend row's Normal label and the title, because each listener hears the document it shows. The two-document half, a stroke in one composites that easel alone and a change of space behind the front one moves nothing, is the suite of the same name.
